allow: Bash(bun -e "const y=await Bun.file\('bmad/status.yaml'\).text\(\); const {parse}=await import\('yaml'\).catch\(\(\)=>\({}\)\); if\(parse\){const d=parse\(y\); console.log\('YAML OK — sprints:',d.sprints.map\(s=>s.id+':'+s.status\).join\(' | '\)\); console.log\('bugs:',d.qa.bugs.map\(b=>b.id+'='+b.status\).join\(' '\)\); console.log\('backlog:',d.backlog.map\(b=>b.id+'='+\(b.status||'open'\)\).join\(' '\)\);} else console.log\('yaml pkg absent'\)")
